# ImmyBot

> ImmyBot is an automation platform for MSPs and internal IT teams that turns IT standards into repeatable automation for computer onboarding, software deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

ImmyBot's model is "you set the rules and ImmyBot does the work": you define what belongs on every computer (apps, settings, configurations), and ImmyBot applies it during one-click onboarding, deploys and updates software across clients, and detects and corrects drift over time. Remote access is included at no extra cost.

Key facts:
- Integrates with PSAs, RMMs, and Azure, including ConnectWise Automate, ConnectWise Manage, HaloPSA, and Microsoft Azure; integration data can be used to target computers and users.
- Includes a library of 1,800+ pre-written PowerShell scripts, plus a script editor for custom scripts.
- Security: each customer instance is isolated with separate databases, services, and storage; sign-in uses Microsoft Entra ID; SOC 2 Type II compliant.
- Pricing: unlimited computer onboarding for a flat monthly fee, plus paid monthly maintenance slots for ongoing automation. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. See the Pricing page for current details.

Where to look:
- New to ImmyBot: start with Introduction, Quick Start Guide, Core Concepts, and Terminology under Documentation.
- Setup, features, integrations, and troubleshooting: the Documentation section.
- Whether a specific application has a deployment script: the Script Library section and catalog.

## Script Library

The full catalog of 1,800+ scripts is searchable at https://www.immy.bot/script-library/. To check whether a specific application is supported, search that page. The scripts below also have dedicated pages.

- [Bitdefender](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/bitdefender/): Endpoint security suite providing antivirus, anti-ransomware and threat prevention.
- [Blackpoint Snap Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/blackpoint-snap-agent/): Endpoint sensor feeding Blackpoint Cyber's managed detection and response service.
- [CloudRadial Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/cloudradial-agent/): Endpoint agent for CloudRadial, the client-facing support and reporting portal used by MSPs.
- [ConnectSecure Vulnerability Scan Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/connectsecure-vulnerability-scan-agent/): Agent that scans the endpoint and local network for vulnerabilities and reports to ConnectSecure.
- [ConnectWise Automate Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/connectwise-automate-agent/): Endpoint agent for ConnectWise Automate RMM, handling monitoring, scripting and patching.
- [ConnectWise RMM (Asio) Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/connectwise-rmm-asio-agent/): Endpoint agent for ConnectWise RMM on the Asio platform, formerly Continuum.
- [CrowdStrike Windows Sensor](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/crowdstrike-windows-sensor/): CrowdStrike Falcon endpoint sensor, providing EDR telemetry and next-generation antivirus.
- [DattoRMM Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/dattormm-agent/): Endpoint agent for Datto RMM, handling monitoring, patching and remote access.
- [HP Image Assistant](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/hp-image-assistant/): HP's analysis and update tool, comparing a machine against HP's reference and applying driver, BIOS and software updates.
- [Huntress Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/huntress-agent/): Huntress endpoint agent, feeding their managed detection and response service and persistent-foothold hunting.
- [N-Central Agent v2 (Integration)](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/n-central-agent-v2-integration/)
- [NinjaOne Agent (Integration)](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/ninjaone-agent-integration/)
- [Sophos Endpoint Agent](https://www.immy.bot/script-library/sophos-endpoint-agent/)
